RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly assign a number from these facts.

An all-male panel is worth raising as a question about process, but it does not establish that sex influenced the decision. Your qualifications merit serious consideration; the announcement alone cannot show how the candidates compared against the selection criteria.

Follow up in writing for the explanation, assessment criteria, your scores, and any applicable panel-composition rules. Ask neutrally whether those rules were followed.

Check complaint and appeal deadlines now: waiting for an explanation may not stop them. Two weeks’ silence does not itself prove bias or a legal breach. A union representative or local employment adviser can assess your options; the governing rules depend on the jurisdiction.
